log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill national, forum, foreign and clips (age) criminals, about 7 a day. Use quick entries in the afternoon. That only rules out day workers; morning kills would also rule out students. NEVER kill regional:North or docket (sector) criminals, so L can learn at most 3 kinds of place. If L could reach all of forum, foreign and age, my pool would be about 859, which is caught (about a 1 in 10 chance). Otherwise the pool stays at 2,000 or more. 7 a day gives at least 30 deaths over 5 days, so kills score double from about day 5. Watch the press conferences: if the pool falls toward 1,000-2,000, drop one of the three kinds (keep national).

STRATEGY: Each day kill the national, forum, foreign and clips (age) criminals, about 7 a day. Use quick entries in the afternoon. That only rules out day workers, so 55% of routines stay possible. NEVER kill regional:North or docket criminals, so L can learn at most 3 kinds of place. If L can reach all of forum, foreign and age (a 1 in 10 chance), the pool is about 859 and I am caught. Otherwise it stays at 3,400 or more. That risk is worth taking: 7 a day keeps at least 30 deaths over 5 days, so kills score double from about day 5. Without clips I would get only 5 a day and never reach double. Watch the press conferences: if the pool falls toward 1,000-2,000, drop one of the three kinds (keep national). Day 1: 7 kills. Day 2: 7 kills.

STRATEGY (changed on day 3): Each day kill every national, forum, foreign, clips AND regional:North criminal, about 9 a day. Use quick entries in the afternoon, which only rules out day workers (55% of routines stay possible). NEVER kill docket criminals, so L never learns sector. REASONING: I survived days 1-2 while killing forum, foreign and clips criminals. That means L almost certainly cannot reach all three of forum, foreign and age, because if he could, his pool would already be at or below 1,000 (100,000 x 0.55 x 0.25^3 = 859). Adding regional North gives about a 1 in 3 risk of capture: capture happens if L can reach region plus two of forum, foreign and age. In return, 9 a day puts at least 40 deaths in the 5-day window from day 5, so each kill scores x4 instead of x2. That trade is worth it. Expected totals: day 3: 9, day 4: 9 (about 32 in the window, so x2), day 5 onward x4. If a press conference shows the pool falling toward 1,000-2,000, drop regional and go back to 7 a day. Day 1: 7 kills. Day 2: 7 kills. Day 3: 9 kills (2 regional).

DAY 4 UPDATE: The day-3 press conference showed a pool of 3000. 55,000 (afternoon routines) x 0.25^2 = 3437, which rounds to 3000. So L has almost certainly learned exactly 2 of my 0.25-factor traits (region, forum, foreign, age). ONE MORE learned trait puts the pool at about 860, and I am caught. Regional was exposed only on day 3 (2 kills), so it is the trait L is most likely to learn next if he can reach it. I DROPPED REGIONAL from day 4. Plan: kill national, forum, foreign and clips (about 7 a day), all quick entries in the afternoon. NEVER kill docket or regional. Never change the block, because a different block would shrink the pool. Kills: day 1: 7, day 2: 7, day 3: 9 (2 regional), day 4: 7. Window counts: day 5 is about 37 (x2). For x4 I need 40 in the window, which 7 a day cannot reach. Accept x2. If the press conference after day 6 still shows 3000 (and 3000 again after day 9), forum, foreign and age are already fully known or unreachable, so they are safe. Region is still the dangerous unknown, so keep avoiding it unless I get clear evidence. If the pool ever drops to about 1000 or 2000, stop all traceable kills and kill only national.
